title: I'm building a 1v1 wizard dueling game with AI-assisted visuals and game design — here's my experience
author: eladmino
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I'm a solo developer working on **Hexbane**, a mobile game focused on short 1v1 wizard duels.

AI has been a big help throughout development, especially since I'm working on the game alone.

**Here's how I'm using AI:**

* **Visual assets:** AI helps me create spell icons, visual effects, and other graphical elements. It's been particularly useful for experimenting with different visual styles.
* **Game design:** One of the most valuable uses has been designing systems that make balancing the game easier later on. Instead of just implementing mechanics, I use AI to explore different approaches and think through how they'll affect gameplay.
* **Experimentation:** AI makes it easier to explore ideas and alternatives without spending too much time on every iteration.

I think the game design aspect is particularly interesting. Generating assets is one thing, but using AI to help design systems that remain flexible and easier to balance as the game grows feels like a much bigger advantage.

**A bit about the game:**

Hexbane is built around short, tactical wizard duels where you:

* Choose your spells before combat.
* Manage mana while attacking and defending.
* Regenerate mana by meditating (swiping up), leaving yourself vulnerable.
* Practice against a training dummy, fight AI opponents, or challenge other players in 1v1 PvP.

Here's a short gameplay video:  
[https://youtube.com/shorts/g9O2-44MG10](https://youtube.com/shorts/g9O2-44MG10)

**The Android beta is live**, and I'd really appreciate some honest feedback!  
  
To join the beta:  
  
1. Join the Google Group: [https://groups.google.com/g/hexbane-testers](https://groups.google.com/g/hexbane-testers)  
2. Become a tester on Google Play: [https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.hexbane.game](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.hexbane.game)  
3. Download the game and give it a try!  
  
**The iOS version is still in development.**  
  
I'm especially interested in feedback on the combat mechanics, spell balancing, and overall gameplay experience.

I'm looking for people willing to try the game and share honest feedback. If you're interested in beta testing, feel free to send me a DM!

I'm also open to collaborating with others interested in the project.

**A question for other AI game developers:**

Are you mainly using AI to generate assets and code, or have you found it useful for designing game mechanics and systems too?

I'd love to hear about your experiences, especially when it comes to balancing gameplay.

Thanks for checking it out! ⚔️
